title: Quota pools
text: Candidates read only the pools their model consumes. A readable included zero blocks only when the surface's fresh paid extra usage is disabled, capped or unfunded; extra usage that is available, unknown or stale leaves the launch to the provider. Unreadable or missing quota is unknown. Claude has a separate 5-hour cap. Cursor has exactly two monthly pools, ordered universe-wide; pool preference affects consumption, never level membership.
evidence: Two Cursor rows proved by QA run 45473 / artifact 32323; current order reread through universe.cursor_quota_order.get, 2026-10-13. Extra-usage gating observed in source and focused tests (runtime/harness/test_extra_usage_readings.py); not yet verified on a deployed release.
